这是一个生成扇形半圆比较网格的工作流程。

它是通过修改而成的任意网格工作流程。如果您想制作自己的非正统形状的网格，请选中两者。

安装和依赖

  1. 安装自定义脚本自定义节点；

  2. 安装阿洛尔自定义节点；

  3. 安装骑自行车的人自定义节点；

  4. 安装WAS 节点套件自定义节点；

  5. 安装化装舞会自定义节点（可以替换为“带遮罩的边界图像裁剪” 和 “带蒙版的有界图像混合“ 节点来自瓦斯，如果您确实想最大程度地减少安装的扩展数量）；

  6. 下载并打开此工作流程。

如何使用

  1. 寻找绿色节点。这些包含主要参数。

  2. 寻找蓝色节点。这些包含您可能还想更改的参数。

  3. （可选）更改“计算变化“组来处理您的图像填充的规则。默认情况下，工作流程会迭代关键字EpiCPhotoGasm公司模型。

  4. 检查额外选项和自动排队ComfyUI 浮动菜单中的复选框，按排队提示.

它将用图像一张一张地填充您的网格，并在完成后自动停止。请注意自动排队结束后取消选中复选框。

已知问题

  • "绘制饼图切片" 节点仅接受英格尔角。如果您的图像数量不是 360 的倍数，您会在图像之间看到一些背景线。

  • "图像变换PaddingAbsolute“节点将重量误认为高度，反之亦然。它可以随时修复，并且工作流程将中断（它可以轻松修复回来）。

o.en:
This is a workflow to generate comparison grids shaped in fan-like half-circle.

It was made by modifiyngAny Gridworkflow. Check both if you want to make your own grid of unorthodox shape.

Installation and dependencies

  1. InstallCustom Scriptscustom nodes;

  2. InstallAllorcustom nodes;

  3. InstallCyclistcustom nodes;

  4. InstallWAS Node Suitecustom nodes;

  5. InstallMasqueradecustom nodes (can be replaced with "Bounded Image Crop with Mask" and "Bounded Image Blend with Mask" nodes fromWAS, if you really want to minimize amount of extension installed);

  6. Download and open this workflow.

How to use

  1. Look for green nodes. These contains primary parameters.

  2. Look for blue nodes. These contains parameters you may also want to change.

  3. (optional) Change "Calculate Changes" group to handle what rule your images are populated by. By default, the workflow iterates through keywords forepiCPhotoGasmmodel.

  4. CheckExtra Options andAuto Queuecheckboxes in ComfyUI floating menu, pressQueue Prompt.

It will fill your grid by images one-by-one, and automatically stops when done. Note thatAuto Queuecheckbox unchecks after the end.

Known Issues

  • "DrawPieSlice" node only accepts ingerer angles. If your image count is not a factor of 360, you'll see little lines of background between images.

  • "ImageTransformPaddingAbsolute" node mistakes weight for height, and vise versa. It can be fixed at any moment, and the workflow will break (it can be easily fixed back).
